audit_metadata.title: Independent Statistical Verification and Pre-Backtest Re-Gate
audit_metadata.auditor_role: Independent Quantitative Research Auditor & Governance Reviewer

finding_a_evt_factor_verification.formula: EVT(K) = (1 - gamma) * Phi_inv(1 - 1/K) + gamma * Phi_inv(1 - 1/(K * e))

numerical_results.discrepancy_explanation: Prior report prose cited 1.800057 due to intermediate manual rounding of q2 to 0.977008 (6 decimals). Production code computes full 64-bit IEEE 754 precision 1.8004542393102163. Discrepancy is +0.000397, which has negligible effect (< 0.008 bps Sharpe) on decisions.

finding_b_dsr_expected_max_formula.primary_literature_source: Bailey, D. H., & Lopez de Prado, M. (2014). The Deflated Sharpe Ratio. Journal of Portfolio Management, 40(5), Eq. 1, p. 96.

tripartite_distinction.1_published_methodology: mu_SR + sigma_SR * EVT(N) under assumption of i.i.d. normal trial estimates.
tripartite_distinction.2_protocol_governance_floor: max(0.0, mu_SR_cohort) introduced as a conservative governance requirement to prevent negative cohort averages from permitting negative hurdle passes.
tripartite_distinction.3_production_implementation: calculate_expected_max_sharpe() computes sample mean mu_sr, Bessel-corrected std sigma_sr (ddof=1), applies max(0, mu_sr), and fails closed if sigma_sr < 1e-6.

finding_c_psr_dsr_standardization.excess_returns_handling: CONSISTENT (daily Rf = 0.06/252 deducted from daily mark-to-market returns)
finding_c_psr_dsr_standardization.time_scale_consistency: CONSISTENT (daily Sharpe and daily hurdle SR_star/sqrt(252) evaluated on daily scale with Mertens variance factor V)

mertens_asymptotic_variance.moment_conventions: gamma_3 is unbiased sample skewness; gamma_4 is sample Pearson kurtosis (normal=3.0, fisher=False)
mertens_asymptotic_variance.gaussian_baseline_check: Under normal returns (gamma_3=0, gamma_4=3), V = 1 + 0.5 * SR_daily^2, exactly matching Lo (2002) asymptotic variance.

finding_c_psr_dsr_standardization.serial_dependence_limitation: Mertens formula assumes serially uncorrelated returns. Strategy holding period up to 5 days induces positive autocorrelation; Newey-West HAC with 5 lags is mandated and implemented as an audited diagnostic.

finding_d_fixed_k16_and_correlation_boun.slepian_lemma_applicability: Slepian (1962) lemma guarantees E[max X_k] <= E[max Z_k] strictly when all pairwise correlations are non-negative (rho_ij >= 0) and marginals are standard normal.
limitations_identified: Negative pairwise correlations reverse Slepian inequality (E[max] > independent case).
Unequal candidate variances violate standard normal marginal requirement.
Heavy-tailed (non-Gaussian) candidate distributions invalidate normal Gumbel quantile approximation.

participation_ratio_diagnostic.bounds: 1.0 <= N_eff <= 16.0 verified analytically and numerically for all valid correlation matrices.
participation_ratio_diagnostic.separation: N_eff diagnostic is strictly isolated in secondary_diagnostics and cannot override the primary binding fixed K=16 decision.

finding_e_cross_sectional_harness_audit.candidate_universe_validation: STRICT (exact 16 candidates CFG-01..CFG-16 required; unexpected IDs or missing IDs rejected)
finding_e_cross_sectional_harness_audit.configuration_integrity: STRICT (threshold, exit_rule, and pacing checked against protocol)
finding_e_cross_sectional_harness_audit.date_alignment_and_sorting: STRICT (identical trading calendar required; duplicate or unsorted dates rejected)
finding_e_cross_sectional_harness_audit.fallback_elimination: VERIFIED (deflated_sharpe_ratio without hurdle returns PENDING_CROSS_SECTIONAL_EVALUATION with NaN p-values; obsolete sqrt(2*ln(K)) eliminated)
finding_e_cross_sectional_harness_audit.engine_trading_logic_impact: ZERO (order execution, sizing, fee deduction, and ATR stops completely unchanged)

finding_f_synthetic_test_evidence.test_isolation: 100% ISOLATED (zero reads from validation_dataset.parquet or test_dataset.parquet; in-memory synthetic fixtures only)

final_recommendation.rationale: All previous blocking defects (BLK-04, BLK-05, DEF-01, DEF-02, DEF-03) are verified as mathematically sound and programmatically robust under synthetic testing. The preregistered protocol v1.2.0 and evaluation harness are fully auditable.
